categories.main_business_segments: QingCloud Technology primarily operates in enterprise-level cloud services and digital solutions, focusing on cloud products, cloud services, AI computing power services, hybrid cloud, cloud-native platforms, and software-defined storage. The company serves industries such as finance, government, education, healthcare, energy, transportation, and manufacturing with a comprehensive portfolio including cloud infrastructure, AI computing platforms, and cloud-native application management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent core code development with advanced technologies including distributed storage (block, file, object storage), software-defined networking (SDN), cloud-native platforms, container orchestration (KubeSphere), AI computing power scheduling, GPU virtualization, and hybrid cloud architectures. It integrates cloud-native, edge computing, AI computing, and software-defined storage technologies to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient cloud solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: QingCloud serves primarily enterprise customers across finance (banks, insurance), government, education, healthcare, energy, transportation, and manufacturing sectors. Key customers include major Chinese banks, government agencies, universities, and large enterprises requiring digital transformation and AI computing power. The company targets clients with stable digitalization needs and AI computing demands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major operations in Beijing and subsidiaries in Chengdu, Suzhou, Wuhan, and Hong Kong. It also has a presence in Indonesia. Its customer base and cloud infrastructure primarily serve domestic markets, with some international outreach through overseas subsidiaries and partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: QingCloud operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cloud computing supply chain, providing cloud infrastructure, platform services, and software solutions to enterprise customers. It procures hardware such as servers and network equipment from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated cloud products and services to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AI computing power platforms, hybrid cloud solutions, cloud-native technologies, and trusted domestic IT infrastructure (Xinchuang). It invests heavily in AI model training and inference platforms, container management, software-defined storage, and edge computing. QingCloud also focuses on expanding its AI computing ecosystem, enhancing compatibility with domestic chips, and deepening industry-specific cloud solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of cloud products (software and integrated hardware solutions) and cloud services (subscription-based, pay-as-you-go resource usage). The company employs direct sales and channel sales models, including reseller buyout for products and commission-based agency for cloud services. It also earns from after-sales support, maintenance services, and customized development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: QingCloud competes in a market dominated by large cloud providers like Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure. While its public cloud scale is smaller, it holds a competitive position in hybrid cloud, AI computing power, and cloud-native platforms, with recognized strengths in domestic trusted IT infrastructure and AI cloud services. It is considered a leading domestic enterprise cloud service provider with a focus on innovation and industry-specific solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, QingCloud reported revenues of approximately RMB 272 million, a decrease of 18.95% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 95.76 million, showing a reduced loss compared to previous years. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D (over 24% of revenue) and infrastructure, with total assets around RMB 577 million. Despite ongoing losses, the company is improving operational efficiency and expanding high-margin business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: QingCloud emphasizes truly independent core technology development, offering secure, reliable, and flexible cloud solutions tailored to enterprise digital transformation needs. Its unified public-private cloud architecture ensures consistent delivery and management, reducing operational complexity. The company differentiates through its AI computing power platform, cloud-native ecosystem, and trusted domestic IT infrastructure compatibility, providing customers with scalable, efficient, and secure cloud services that support AI and hybrid cloud scenarios.
